accepted.sentence: At a roadside breakdown, a mechanic tightens the nut securing a replacement battery cable to its terminal.
In an aircraft hangar, maintenance crews secure access-panel fasteners before returning an inspected plane to service.
Aboard a sailboat, deckhands tighten hose-clamp fittings while checking the vessel's cooling-water lines.
During irrigation repairs, workers tighten compression fittings to reconnect sections of a farm's water-supply piping.
At a factory, maintenance staff secure conveyor guards after clearing debris from the machinery.
When assembling a laboratory equipment stand, technicians tighten its metal frame joints before placing instruments on it.
In a flat-pack furniture workshop, assemblers tighten bolts joining a table's legs to its frame.
At a rail depot, technicians tighten fasteners on service equipment during scheduled maintenance between train runs.
